snippet.title: Happy 10th Anniversary, N++!
snippet.description:
a.k.a. TEN++ :D

We first released N++ on PS4 10 years ago, and over the years, we've enthusiastically watched as players from all over the world have enjoyed the game: playing and streaming, getting together in real life to host and compete in tournaments, making huge packs of levels and releasing them for other players to enjoy, and generally being supportive, kind, and interesting people in the N++ discord community ( https://discord.com/invite/nplusplus ). 

We wanted to thank you for playing, and for telling other people (including us!) how you feel about N++. So to celebrate TEN++, we made you a gift: a free update to N++ with our most challenging solo, co-op and race levels yet, plus a handful of new colour palettes (6!) to enjoy. It's out now on Steam and coming soon to consoles. We hope this will keep you playing for another ten++ years ;) 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/230270/N_NPLUSPLUS/

Much love,
Mare and Raigan (Metanet Software)

ps we're working on something we think you'll be very interested in! Please sign up here to be among the first to hear the news, and check out the beta: https://www.metanetsoftware.com/newgame

We'll even include some exclusive details just for newsletter subscribers! oooooh

(if you were subscribed to our mailing list already, thank you! Please sign up to this one as we're migrating to a new system)

video production by: abho
music: "Family" by Sam A La Bamalot https://samalabamalot.bandcamp.com/album/reminisce

For more about N++, check out: https://nplusplus.org/
